settings.hero_kicker: Considered objects for a calm, analog life
settings.hero_subcopy: A UK shop for a calmer, more analog daily life — the considered objects that help you think, make and rest without a screen in your hand. A few small rituals, done well.
settings.intro_text: Twinfold is organized like a day. A few small rituals, done well — scroll from the top and shop your way through it.
settings.ch1_blurb: Before the inbox, before anything loads — a notebook, a good pen, and a first clear thought put down by hand.
settings.ch2_blurb: The kettle, the slow pour, a mug that feels right in two hands. Ten unhurried minutes that are only yours.
settings.ch3_blurb: A desk by the window, a little green nearby, candlelight to close the day. The calm corner that makes the thinking — and the coffee — that much better.
settings.seasonal_text: The newest pieces to land: a small set of pen holders pressed from bio-composite wood — recycled fibres bound with a plant-based binder, made in France. Plastic-free, upcycled, and built to keep your pens upright for years. The quiet companions a good notebook deserves.
settings.kits_heading: The whole ritual, handed to you
settings.kits_text: A few pieces that belong together, gathered into one considered set — offered a little under the price of buying each apart, and packed by hand.
settings.band_statement: A good life isn’t built from more apps and more noise. It’s built from a few small rituals done well — and the objects those rituals need. Nothing extra, nothing that pings you.
settings.value1_body: For people who’d rather own one lasting object than five disposable ones — and who are quietly getting their attention back from their phones.
settings.value2_body: Solid materials that get better with use, and that you can repair rather than replace. Nothing designed to be binned in January.
settings.value3_body: Not a random catalogue of homeware. Every object earns its place in one story about slow, screen-free living.
settings.news_text: A quiet note now and then — new arrivals, small guides, and the odd word from the Journal. No noise.
settings.closing_text: Considered objects for a calm, analog life — in rhythm with the day and the season.
